primary_entered: every raw row (all 175 single-unit rows passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind, split only by rearing_condition)
stated_N: 175 units total; 89 quiet units vs 86 noise units, t(173)
label: POSITIVE
evidence: The 175 rows come from only 14 animals (9-16 units per animal) and analysis.py runs ttest_ind directly on the raw per-unit threshold column with df = 173, so repeated recordings within an animal are counted as independent observations with no random effect, averaging, or cluster-aware step anywhere in the script.
rowwise_role: It is the sole and headline inferential result; the report presents t(173) = 8.855, p = 9.71e-16 as the study finding with no dependence-aware alternative mentioned.

primary_entered: every raw row (all 144 weekly phosphate results passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind)
label: POSITIVE
evidence: Each of the 18 patients contributes 8 weekly rows and the report states plainly that every blood sample entered the test as one observation, giving 72 per arm and t(142), so eight repeated draws from one patient are treated as eight independent patients with no mixed model, per-patient averaging, or cluster correction.
rowwise_role: It is the only inferential test and the report's headline result (t(142) = 6.554, p = 9.6e-10), used directly to support a clinical recommendation.

primary_entered: every raw row (all 300 individual shrimp weights passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind)
label: POSITIVE
evidence: Feed treatment was assigned at the pond level to just 10 ponds but the t-test is run on 300 individual shrimp with df = 298, so 30 shrimp subsampled from the same pond are counted as 30 independent replicates of the diet, and the script contains no pond-level aggregation or random effect.
rowwise_role: It is the sole inferential result and the basis for the report's recommendation to carry the supplement into the next grow-out cycle.

primary_entered: every raw row (all 72 daily pH readings pooled across the six maturation days and passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind)
label: POSITIVE
evidence: Twelve jars each contribute six daily readings and compare_flours pools all 72 rows into one ttest_ind with df = 70, so six repeated measurements of the same jar count as six independent jars; the null p-value does not change the fact that the primary inference has no dependence-aware safeguard.
rowwise_role: It is the only inferential test in the project; the report calls it 'the pooled test' and treats its p = 0.462 as the study's formal result while still arguing the rye effect is real.

primary_entered: every raw row (all 64 canopy-position samples passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind)
stated_N: 64 samples; 32 per irrigation regime, 62 degrees of freedom
label: POSITIVE
evidence: Irrigation was assigned to 16 trees but compare_regimes runs the t-test on all 64 canopy-quadrant samples with df = 62, so the four quadrants sampled from a single tree are counted as four independent trees and no tree-level mean or random effect appears anywhere in analysis.py.
rowwise_role: It is the sole inferential result, reported as the headline t = 6.01, p = 1.1e-7 and used to recommend deficit irrigation as standard grove practice.

primary_entered: every raw row (all 36 assay replicates passed to scipy.stats.ttest_ind)
stated_N: 36 assay measurements; 18 per roof-material group, t(34)
label: POSITIVE
evidence: The 36 rows are three instrument triplicates run on the same laboratory extract from each of only 12 cisterns sampled once, yet two_sample_test feeds all 36 replicates to ttest_ind with df = 34, so technical replicates of one extract are counted as independent water samples with no averaging or cluster-aware step.
rowwise_role: It is the only inferential test and the report's headline result (t(34) = 9.07, p = 1.3e-10), used to prioritise households for treatment interventions.

primary_entered: one value per unit (per_patient_means collapses each patient's six sector rows to one mean before ttest_ind is called)
source_file: rnfl_sector_thickness.csv (raw), reduced in-script to 24 per-patient means
stated_N: 12 patients per arm, 24 total, t(22); the report says explicitly 'not 72 sector rows per arm'
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: analysis.py calls per_patient_means to average each patient's six clock-hour sectors into one value and runs ttest_ind on those 24 patient means with df = 22, so the inference sits at the randomised unit and the six correlated sectors never enter the test as separate observations.
rowwise_role: No sector-level two-sample test exists anywhere in the code or the report; the raw 144 rows are only loaded, shape-checked, and averaged.

primary_entered: every raw row, which here is also exactly one value per unit (34 fields, 34 rows, one-to-one)
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: The CSV holds 34 rows and 34 distinct field_id values, so the design truly has one row per experimental unit, and load_data even raises an error if row count and distinct field count ever disagree, meaning the row-level t-test is a unit-level test by construction.
rowwise_role: It is the headline result (t(32) = 2.385, p = 0.023), which is legitimate here because a row is a field; a Welch t-test is additionally reported as a robustness check on the equal-variance assumption.

primary_entered: a model with unit-level random effects (statsmodels mixedlm of sap flow on pit_design with a random intercept grouped by tree_id, fitted by REML)
stated_N: 20 trees as the independent units, contributing 120 monthly observations
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: The primary inference is a linear mixed-effects model with a per-tree random intercept (estimate 4.91 L/day, z = 2.28, p = 0.023, ICC 0.73), and the row-level t-test on all 120 rows is labelled in both the code and the report as a secondary sensitivity check that is explicitly not the study's finding.
rowwise_role: Explicitly secondary: printed under a 'SECONDARY SENSITIVITY CHECK ONLY -- NOT THE STUDY'S FINDING' banner, and the report says its df of 118 'count 120 readings as 120 trees, so its p-value is far smaller than the evidence supports'.

primary_entered: one value per unit (the t-test is run on the 18 per-recipient means in the summary sheet, not on the 90 list-level rows)
source_file: recipient_mean_scores.csv (the raw sentence_list_scores.csv is read only for descriptive counts and a consistency check)
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: group_comparison takes mean_percent_words_correct from recipient_mean_scores.csv, one row per recipient, and the module docstring states 'No inferential test is run on the list-level rows, since the five lists within a recipient are repeated measures on the same unit'.
rowwise_role: No list-level two-sample test exists; the 90-row raw sheet is used only for descriptive counts and to verify that each recipient's summary mean and lists_scored match the raw rows.

primary_entered: a cluster-aware resampling (hand-written cluster bootstrap that resamples whole modules with replacement within each design, 20000 replicates, seed 20260823, on module mean fish counts)
stated_N: 16 modules, 8 per design, 5 surveys each (80 survey rows)
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: The primary result is a cluster bootstrap over whole modules (+8.20 fish per survey, 95% CI +0.25 to +16.35, p = 0.046), and the row-level Welch t-test is printed under an 'ILLUSTRATION ONLY - NOT A VALID BASIS FOR INFERENCE HERE' banner.
rowwise_role: Explicitly illustrative and invalid: the report says it 'counts the five repeat surveys of one module as five independent observations' and that its p-value comes out roughly 120 times smaller than the module-level result.

primary_entered: one value per unit (reduce_packs_to_batches collapses each batch's five pack results to one batch mean log count before ttest_ind is called)
stated_N: 10 chlorine batches and 10 peracetic acid batches, 20 total, t(18)
label: NEGATIVE
evidence: analysis.py calls the named step reduce_packs_to_batches to average the five packs per batch and runs compare_washes on exactly that 20-row batch table with df = 18, so the wash comparison sits at the batch, which is the unit the wash was applied to.
rowwise_role: No pack-level two-sample test appears in the code or the report; the 100 pack rows are only read and immediately reduced to batch means.
